  "recovered_c": "#include <stdint.h>\n#include <stddef.h>\n\n#define VERA_ERR 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF\n\nuint64_t fn_01(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, uint64_t arg, uint8_t *out, size_t out_cap) {\n    uint32_t h = 0xFFFFFFFF;\n    size_t i;\n    uint32_t b;\n\n    for (i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n        h ^= in[i];\n        for (b = 0; b < 8; b++) {\n            h = -(h & 1) & 0xEDB88320 ^ (h >> 1);\n        }\n    }\n    return (uint64_t)~h;\n}"
}
